name: two speed, first system
note: Both ratios 1:1, which is not a useful gearbox and is the point: 16 is the only tooth count the first clutch system makes, and a pair only frames when its teeth sum to a multiple of 16, so 16+16 is the only pair available to it. It exists to exercise the first system's hardware — the 6539 ring, the 6542a clutch gears, and the 6641 catch whose position was read out of LDraw's official 8448.
